sloka: निमिस्तु राजा विप्रांस्तान्समानीय नराधिपः ।अयजद्धिमवत्पार्श्वे स्वपुरस्य समीपतः ।पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि राजा दीक्षामुपागमत् ।। ७.५५.१२ ॥
transliteration: nimistu rājā viprāṁstānsamānīya narādhipaḥ ।ayajaddhimavatpārśve svapurasya samīpataḥ ।pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā dīkṣāmupāgamat ।। 7.55.12 ॥

translations.english: King Nimi, the lord of men, however, gathered those brahmins and performed a sacrifice near his own city, on the side of the Himalayas, undertaking the sacrificial vow for five thousand years.
